svg.title: Spectrum of the prefix-sum operator approaches a law with no atom at zero
svg.desc: Histograms of the eigenvalues of T T*/m, where T = 1 + U_1 + ... + U_m and the U_j are independent Haar-random 1000 x 1000 unitary matrices, for m = 1, 4 and 40. The dashed curve is the limit density (1/2 pi) sqrt((4 - x)/x) on (0, 4) from Lemma 4.3 of the paper. The shaded strip near zero is the part of the spectrum a cutoff would discard.
svg.text: The spectrum of T T*/m crowds toward 0 but puts no point mass there
eigenvalues, 1000 × 1000 random unitaries (a finite model of free Haar unitaries)
limit law of Lemma 4.3: density (1/2π)√((4 − x)/x), moments 1, 1, 2, 5, 14, … (Catalan)
cutoff strip [0, d], here d = 0.1: limit mass 0.20, and it tends to 0 as d → 0 (≈ (2/π)√d)
